# Psalm 143 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 143:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For has-pursued the-enemy my-soul; he-has-crushed to-the-ground my-life; he-has-made-me-sit in-dark-places like-the-dead-of long-ago.
- **LOGOS:** For the enemy has pursued my soul; he has crushed my life to the ground; he has made me sit in darkness like those long dead.
- **PNEUMA:** The enemy has hunted me down; he's crushed me into the ground; he's forced me to live in darkness like someone long dead.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 143:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-faints upon-me my-spirit; within-me is-desolate my-heart.
- **LOGOS:** Therefore my spirit faints within me; my heart within me is appalled.
- **PNEUMA:** My spirit is giving out inside me; my heart is numb with shock.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 143:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-remember the-days of-old; I-meditate on-all your-deeds; on-work-of your-hands I-muse.
- **LOGOS:** I remember the days of old; I meditate on all that you have done; I ponder the work of your hands.
- **PNEUMA:** I think back to the old days; I reflect on everything you've done; I consider the works of your hands.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 143:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Cause-me-to-hear in-the-morning your-steadfast-love, for in-you I-trust; make-me-know the-way in-which I-should-walk, for to-you I-lift my-soul.
- **LOGOS:** Let me hear in the morning of your steadfast love, for in you I trust. Make me know the way I should walk, for to you I lift up my soul.
- **PNEUMA:** Let me hear about your faithful love in the morning, because I trust you. Show me the path I should take, because I've entrusted my life to you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 143:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Deliver-me from-my-enemies O-YHWH; to-you I-have-hidden.
- **LOGOS:** Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD! I have fled to you for refuge.
- **PNEUMA:** Rescue me from my enemies, LORD — I've come to you for protection.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 143:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-sake-of your-name O-YHWH revive-me; in-your-righteousness bring-out from-distress my-soul.
- **LOGOS:** For your name's sake, O LORD, preserve my life! In your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, for the sake of your name, keep me alive! Because you are righteous, bring me out of this trouble.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
